symptom: alter entity … modify attribute D: DateTime (any modify of a DateTime, e.g. to add not null) turns a Studio Pro non-localized DateTime (Localize unticked) back into a localized one
cause: the MODIFY ATTRIBUTE handler rebuilt attr.Type with convertDataType, which always set LocalizeDate true; the #743 carry of the stored value was wired into create or modify (carryStoredAttributeState) but not into this second rebuild site
insight: A carry fixed per statement misses every other call site that rebuilds the same element — grep the converter (convertDataType) for callers, not the reported statement. Once the property gained a spelling (`not localized`, #1373) the AST had to be tri-state (unstated / localized / not localized) so the carry applies only when unstated and a stated value wins
